name: waynestate/preflight
description: GitLab CI/CD components and a reusable GitHub Actions workflow for WSU PHP packages.

scripts-descriptions.ci: The full CI gate: template lint, fixture tests, Pint, PHPStan, agent-ready files, docs site.
scripts-descriptions.site:agent-ready: Rewrite the Markdown twins, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, robots.txt and sitemap.xml in site/ (Squire's agent-ready kit).
scripts-descriptions.site:agent-ready-check: Fail when the agent-ready files are stale, a page lacks its Markdown link, a prompt drifts from the docs, or the kit was edited here.
scripts-descriptions.docs: Build the docs site from docs/ into site/docs/ (Squire's docs builder): render the pages, fill the generated command and environment reference, and stamp the current version.
scripts-descriptions.docs:check: Fail when the built docs site is stale or the generated command or environment reference has drifted from the CLI or source.
